utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira — that helps a lot. I’ll stick to the plan and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll let you know if I hear anything useful while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what still needs fixing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly the loose board near the curb and that cracked patch by the gate. I can grab the tools if you want to tackle it this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help this afternoon. Let’s do the curb board first and then patch the gate.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, just to be clear, the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still happening — I just want to make sure the timing and drop-off details are clear first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so it’s definitely still on? I just want to confirm the timing and drop-off once more.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I meant to ask if there’s anything I can bring or help with; I’m a bit forgetful, but I’d be glad to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — we could use tape, a few screws, and maybe a flashlight if you’ve got one. If you can help sort the boxes, that’d be a big help too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I can do that — tape, screws, and a flashlight. I’ll help sort the boxes too, if you can point me to where I should start.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to double-check the details before we do anything—what exactly needs repairing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the drive. I think it’s mostly the cracked part near the entrance and maybe the loose edge by the curb, but I might be missing something.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—that helps. I’ll check the cracked section near the entrance and the loose curb edge first, then see if anything else needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Dane — we could use a few basic tools, some screws, and maybe work gloves if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ve got work gloves and a small tool kit I can bring. I’ll grab some screws on the way over too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, Gus — what do you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring over my drill, hammer, and a box of screws for the repair drive. Just let me know what you want me to drop off.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be great, Gus — please bring the drill, hammer, and screws over when you can. I’ll make sure we put them to good use for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t got any repair drive details yet, but I can keep an eye on where it’s happening. If you want, I’ll track it down and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — that’d be really helpful. Please let me know as soon as you find the repair drive location and time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep checking and let you know as soon as I find the repair drive location and time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are still dropping off tools and cash over by the community hall. If you want, I can tell you what they’re asking for most.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, absolutely—tell me what they need most, and I’ll spread the word around the block right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: They’re short on cordless drills, extension cords, and volunteer hands for Saturday morning. If you can tell folks to check the community hall by noon, that’d help a ton.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we meeting here for the repair drive, or should I bring my tools over?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Bring your tools over if you can — that’ll make things easier. I’ll be here to help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring my tools over עכשיו.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m heading over to the repair drive later, and I’ll let the others know the plan too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’d appreciate the heads-up since I’m usually a bit behind on these things. Let me know if there’s anything I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check what they need and tell you if you should bring anything. I’ll pass the plan along to the others too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m putting the repair drive details in order now, Uli. If you’ve got any fixes or supplies to add, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll think it over and send you anything I can add.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thank you, Uli. I’ll keep everything organized and wait for your additions.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely—folks are pitching in and getting the word around. If you want, I can keep an ear out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be much appreciated, Tess. I’ll keep to the plan and check in when there’s something new.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Eli—I’ll let you know if I hear anything useful. Thanks for keeping steady with it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late—what’s left to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I’ll just remind folks about the drop-off table and the tool check, then we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can help remind people about the drop-off table too, and check on the tools if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I still need to sort the parts list and check what’s already been promised.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can sort the parts list if you want, and I’ll check what’s already been promised too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what's the repair drive need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: If you can, bring your repair request details and the location of the issue so I can log it accurately.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring the repair details and the issue location.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help connect folks for the repair drive—who still needs a hand?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me check the list carefully before I say who still needs help. If you’ve got it handy, send me the names and I’ll sort through them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll send the names over now, and you can sort through them at your pace.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I might’ve missed the latest update; what changed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We pushed the drive back a week so more folks can bring things by, and we’ve got a couple extra volunteers now. I can send you the updated flyer if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that would help—please send the updated flyer. Thanks, Mara.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like the repair drive is getting moving—what do you need me to keep an eye out for?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: If you spot a good ladder or a set of screwdrivers, I could use those. I’ll keep sorting the donations and let you know what else we need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out for a ladder and screwdrivers while I’m out. I’ll swing back by if I find anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help out with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — can you ask a few neighbors if they’ve got tools or spare parts to donate?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll ask around the block and see who has tools or spare parts to donate.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the timing and where everything needs to go first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — it starts Saturday morning, and we’re sorting donations at the community hall first, then taking tools over to the repair shed. Do you want the exact drop-off times too?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please — the exact drop-off times would help me plan my route and avoid making extra trips.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, absolutely—I'm in. I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and see who can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — that would help a lot. I’ll make sure we’ve got the supplies ready for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll start inviting folks this afternoon and let you know who’s coming.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m still waiting on the final time. I’ll check and let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren — just send it when you know, and I’ll work around the school pickup schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Nell — I’m organizing the repair drive list now, and I’ll keep things moving so neighbors know what’s next.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’m just hearing things second-hand, so I’d appreciate any updates you can share. If you need me to pass anything along, I can do that.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll send you a clear update once I’ve got the list finalized, and if you hear any repair needs, just pass them my way.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of where the repair drive is happening, so I can point people the right way. Where should I tell folks to go?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Tell folks to head to the community center on Maple, right by the library. I’ll be there to help direct everyone in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll send people to the community center on Maple by the library. Thanks, Rosa; I’ll tell them you’ll be there to direct everyone in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is getting a lot of support, but I’m still catching up on the details. What’s the latest from your side?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s shaping up nicely — folks are signing up fast, and there’s a pretty good mix of tools, volunteers, and donations coming in. I’ll send you the latest invite details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks — I’m a bit behind, so I’ll watch for the invite details and fill in the blanks from there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring a box of screws and some tape for the repair drive. If you need anything else, let me know and I’ll check my stash.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo — that would help a lot. I’ll let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll set those aside and bring them by. Just send word if the list grows.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m happy to help; I just need a quick reminder of what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren — could you bring a Phillips screwdriver, some masking tape, and a few spare batteries? If you have them, a small flashlight would help too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll bring a Phillips screwdriver, masking tape, spare batteries, and I’ll look for a small flashlight too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think it’s sometime after school, but I’m not totally sure. I should check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, that’d help. Just let me know once you confirm the time, and I’ll plan around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring a few tools over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Gus. I really appreciate you coming by — it means a lot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to help, Uli — I’ll swing by with the tools and we’ll get it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet — what’s the update on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I don’t have the latest yet—have you seen whether they’ve set a date or started collecting parts?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not yet—I haven’t seen a date posted or any parts collection started. I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help, but I’d like a clear plan first. Tell me what needs fixing and when the repair drive is happening.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re fixing the busted fence, the loose porch step, and a few leaky gutters. The repair drive is this Saturday morning, and I’ll keep everyone posted with the details.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me. Please send the exact time and any tools I should bring, and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what kind of help do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, just the usual—donations, a few tools, and maybe someone handy for pickup runs. I’m trying to spread the word around the block.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help spread the word and do a pickup run if you need me to.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Leo, I’m a bit late—what’s left for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly the small tools and a few boxes to sort. If you can, just grab the drill and tape on your way over.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll bring the drill and tape over now.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Mara — I’m skimming the list now, but I still need to check what’s left and then I’ll send you the top few tasks.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — send me the top few when you’ve got them, and I’ll take one.
